messages.subject: Error in ggplot(data.root) : object 'data.root' not found......and many more errors in the script..
parts:
Can anybody help me to figure out what actually is the problem for these many errors...??


The script and the execution error is together below: Thank you in advance...

# install.packages ('ggplot2') 
> library (ggplot2)
> # install.packages ('scales') 
> library (scales)
>
> # install.packages ('doBy')
> library (doBy)
Loading required package: multcomp
Loading required package: mvtnorm
Loading required package: survival
Loading required package: splines
Loading required package: TH.data
Loading required package: MASS
>
> #########################
> # Rate trace processing #
> #########################
> data = read.table ("rate-trace.txt", header=T)
Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection
In addition: Warning message:
In file(file, "rt") :
  cannot open file 'rate-trace.txt': No such file or directory
> data$Node = factor (data$Node)
Error in data$Node : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable
> data$FaceId <- factor(data$FaceId)
Error in data$FaceId : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable
> data$Kilobits <- data$Kilobytes * 8
Error in data$Kilobytes : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable
> data$Type = factor (data$Type)
Error in data$Type : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable
>
> # exlude irrelevant types
> data = subset (data, Type %in% c("InInterests", "OutInterests", "InData", "OutData"))
Error in match(x, table, nomatch = 0L) : object 'Type' not found
>
> # combine stats from all faces
> data.combined = summaryBy (. ~ Time + Node + Type, data=data, FUN=sum)
Error in rep.int("1", nrow(data)) : incorrect type for second argument
>  
> data.root = subset (data.combined, Node == "root")
Error in subset(data.combined, Node == "root") :
  object 'data.combined' not found
> data.leaves = subset (data.combined, Node %in% c("leaf-1", "leaf-2", "leaf-3", "leaf-4"))
Error in subset(data.combined, Node %in% c("leaf-1", "leaf-2", "leaf-3",  :
  object 'data.combined' not found
>
> # graph rates on all nodes in Kilobits
> g.all <- ggplot (data.combined) +
+   geom_point (aes (x=Time, y=Kilobits.sum, color=Type), size=1) +
+   ylab ("Rate [Kbits/s]") +
+   facet_wrap (~ Node)
Error in ggplot(data.combined) : object 'data.combined' not found
>
> print (g.all)
Error in print(g.all) : object 'g.all' not found
>  
> # graph rates on the root nodes in Packets
> g.root <- ggplot (data.root) +
+   geom_point (aes (x=Time, y=Kilobits.sum, color=Type), size=2) +
+   geom_line (aes (x=Time, y=Kilobits.sum, color=Type), size=0.5) +
+   ylab ("Rate [Kbits/s]")
Error in ggplot(data.root) : object 'data.root' not found
>
> print (g.root)
Error in print(g.root) : object 'g.root' not found
>
> png ("root-rates.png", width=500, height=250)
> print (g.root)
Error in print(g.root) : object 'g.root' not found
> dev.off ()
